# umami_websites (Data Source)

List Umami websites. Without `team_id`, lists the websites the authenticated user owns and those of teams where the user is owner or manager.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "umami_websites" "client" {
  team_id = "5e1ba5a1-263f-4edc-ba3a-988342134d17"
}

data "umami_websites" "staging" {
  search = "staging."
}

output "client_website_ids" {
  value = { for w in data.umami_websites.client.websites : w.domain => w.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Only list websites whose name or domain contains this text.
- `team_id` (String) Only list the websites of this team.

### Read-Only

- `websites` (Attributes List) The matching websites. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--websites))

<a id="nestedatt--websites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `websites`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `created_by` (String) ID of the user that created the website.
- `domain` (String) Domain of the website.
- `id` (String) ID (UUID) of the website.
- `name` (String) Display name of the website.
- `team_id` (String) ID of the team that owns the website, if any.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user that owns the website, if any.
